task_active.doc: bool, true once a pick-and-place task (an object to fetch and a drop-off station to bring it to) has been commanded this episode.

holding.doc: bool, true while the gripper's force sensing reports an object held. Measured at the gripper, not reported by the task executor.

object_x.doc: float, metres. X of the object as perception sees it, in the odometry frame. Follows the object wherever it is: on the floor, or in the gripper.

object_y.doc: float, metres. Y of the object as perception sees it, in the odometry frame.

dropoff_x.doc: float, metres. X of the drop-off station the object must be brought to, in the odometry frame. Part of the commanded task.

dropoff_y.doc: float, metres. Y of the drop-off station, in the odometry frame.

object_dist.doc: float, metres. Planar distance from the robot base (pos_x, pos_y) to the object, recomputed each tick. Small while the object is held (it rides just in front of the robot).

dist_to_dropoff.doc: float, metres. Planar distance from the robot base to the drop-off station, recomputed each tick.

object_to_dropoff.doc: float, metres. Planar distance from the object to the drop-off station, recomputed each tick. Below 0.5 means the object is at the station.
